about_the_game: The haunting beauty of Sunset Hills... those scenes you just couldn't forget. Now, they can stay with you, always, as gorgeous, high-resolution wallpapers. Dive back into the world, and feel the magic of those cherished memories with every glance. It's a small way to say thank you for embracing Sunset Hills and for walking alongside Nico on this incredible adventure.

short_description: Relive the unforgettable moments of Sunset Hills. The scenes that captured your heart are now available as breathtaking wallpapers. Every brushstroke, every detail, evokes the nostalgia and charm of those bygone days. Thank you for being a part of Sunset Hills, and for sharing this journey with Nico
